answers.cause: measured: removed the !o.spawn filter in sessionLines; ownership by conversation or spawn ticket via shared sessionTasks()
answers.absence: a session with no recorded convo and no spawn ticket says 'no task recorded' rather than vanishing; withdrawn questions do not exist as a state in genlock (only answer)
answers.assumption: a session's current task is its in_progress owned ticket, else open, else finished; questions answered via genlock answer drop out because snapshot filters !q.answer
answers.falsify: a session whose ticket owner differs from its state.session would show 'no task recorded'; live run showed all 4 named
